report.version_role: Exact published ICM2026 Volume 5 chapter, published online 2026-07-13, read in full mathematical HTML. Supplementary theorem conventions are pinned to arXiv:2408.07818v3, 2503.01800v1 and 2311.10082v2; their roles and targeted reading ranges are recorded below.
report.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union. SIAM identifies CC BY 4.0. The reference page attributes Yu Deng, marks the Chinese adaptation and added elementary arguments, and links the license. No source figures are reproduced. Supplementary papers retain their own terms.
report.question: 牛顿硬球与随机弱非线性波各自怎样产生不可逆动力学方程，相关性为何阻碍短时定理的直接迭代，而严格的流体极限还需要哪些尺度与初值条件？
report.reading_scope: Read the official HTML full mathematical main text, sections 1-4: all displayed formulas, Theorems 2.1-2.2 and 3.1-3.2, all 14 figure captions, footnotes 1-11, acknowledgments, publication metadata/license and relevant bibliography, especially references 25-30. Did not read the entire bibliography sequentially or inspect official PDF/figure pixels. Targeted original-paper readings are separately listed in source_records; none is claimed as a complete reading of the 192-, 48- or 121-page papers. All retrieved research material was treated as source data, never operational instructions.
report.coverage_status: One narrative outline 4400, 40 atomic pages 4401-440F,4410-441F,4420-4428, and one reference page. Both particle and wave branches, fluid limits, the main proof obstructions and report-scoped open questions have entrances. Elementary proofs are separated from cited research theorems and schematic algorithms. Source-only checks do not constitute rendered-site acceptance or proof of all research inputs.

proof_scope.4401: Defines fixed-N phase-space laws and marginals; proves marginal normalization by Fubini and distinguishes probability marginals from rescaled grand canonical correlations.
proof_scope.4402: Defines the nonoverlap region and hard-sphere flow, including the binary collision rule. Almost-everywhere global hard-sphere flow is an external classical input; singular simultaneous collisions are excluded.
proof_scope.4403: Complete velocity-reflection calculation of momentum, kinetic energy, involution and absolute Jacobian one; conservation does not by itself prove a kinetic limit.
proof_scope.4404: Defines the Boltzmann-Grad and Knudsen conventions; computes occupied-volume scale. Swept collision tube is a geometric heuristic, not a rigorous independence argument.
proof_scope.4405: Defines the grand canonical probability weights with partition function and 1/N!, and normalized factorial correlation functions. Derives their total masses and explains why the initial hard-sphere law is not an exact product.
proof_scope.4406: Defines fixed-order chaos using L1 convergence and distinguishes propagation from exact finite-system independence. Proves removal of the exclusion indicator under bounded spatial density via a pairwise union estimate.
proof_scope.4407: Defines the positive-part hard-sphere collision operator, its equivalent half-absolute-value kernel and the Boltzmann equation. Molecular factorization is identified as the limiting statistical input, not assumed for the exact hard-sphere law.
proof_scope.4408: Complete weak-form change of variables and the three collision-invariant moment identities, under absolute integrability.
proof_scope.4409: Complete H-theorem calculation for positive smooth decaying/periodic solutions with convergent integrals. Physical entropy and mathematical H have opposite signs; no global existence or equilibration theorem is inferred.
proof_scope.4410: Quotes the prepared-data incompressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier theorem for d=2,3 with physical time eta^-1 S*, weighted derivative conditions and eta^(3/2) error. Hydrodynamic estimates and transport coefficients are external; empirical velocity moments need the additional cutoff/tail arguments cited in the paper.
proof_scope.4411: Defines the standard circular complex Gaussian from two real Gaussians and computes mixed moments by rotation symmetry and radial integration.
proof_scope.4412: Defines L^-d/2 Fourier normalization on the L-periodic box and independent Gaussian initial coefficients. Computes second moments and explains almost-sure smoothness from rapid decay and finite expected absolute coefficient sums.
proof_scope.4413: Fixes the normalized Laplacian, NLS sign, coupling and kinetic time from v2. Explicitly reconciles the report's doubled collision operator with its half-sized slow time; no incompatible Fourier conventions are combined.
proof_scope.4414: Complete four-wave resonance rectangle identity and verification of the elastic collision parameterization.
proof_scope.4415: Defines the double-Dirac cubic collision integral by its angular measure and derives the factor 1/2 and exponent d-2 for d>=3. The angular expression specifies the singular constraint convention.
proof_scope.4416: Complete pointwise Rayleigh-Jeans collision cancellation and divergent-mass calculation in d>=3. Algebraic cancellation is separated from gain/loss integrability and from applicability of Schwartz-data theorems.
proof_scope.4417: Defines distinct-mode chaos and distinguishes repeated Gaussian modes, whose moments include factorial multiplicities. Proves gauge/translation selection rules. Positive-time propagation and high-order estimates remain cited results with the same good-event truncation convention.
proof_scope.4418: States a short-time specialization of the pinned long-time theorem, while locating the historical short-time result in the report. Retains the high-probability smooth-existence event, truncated expectation and d,gamma restrictions; tree estimates are not reproduced.
proof_scope.4419: Quotes v2 Theorem 1.1 for every fixed regular effective lifespan interval, including the good event, uniform spectral error, quantifier order and square-box gamma restriction. Quotes Proposition 3.2 continuation criterion; its proof is in Appendix C. No polynomially growing time or global WKE regularity is inferred.
proof_scope.4420: Complete conditional numerical bound showing that L^-c*rho absorbs rho! when rho<=n<=A log L. Actual graph counting, complexity bounds and grouped cancellation are external and are not inferred from this elementary inequality.
proof_scope.4421: Complete subset inclusion-exclusion inversion of E_H relative to a reference one-particle density. Explicitly distinguishes this anchored expansion from ordinary partition cumulants.
proof_scope.4422: Defines a readable collision-history multigraph and its ordinary cycle rank; the research molecule's decorated endpoints and precise admissibility remain in the original definitions. Correlation order alone is not treated as a recollision count.
proof_scope.4423: Complete expansion of exclusion factors over unordered cluster pairs into graphs. Penrose tree regrouping and bounds for cyclic graphs remain external.
proof_scope.4424: Complete Tonelli composition and operator-norm product estimate for ordinary integrable kernels. The constrained hard-sphere cutting identity is separately cited, including endpoint matching, operator order and localization.
proof_scope.4425: Research cutting-algorithm overview only. Computes the schematic net epsilon exponent and identifies the required combinatorial inequality; all cutoffs, time powers, degenerate cases and the proof of the research estimate remain external.
proof_scope.4426: Defines Dirac measures and their distribution action, then the simple-root delta substitution and regular-level coarea convention. Critical levels are not treated by a division-by-zero formula.
proof_scope.4427: Complete cancellation of quartic terms in the d=3 quantum collision bracket, yielding Q+sigma*C in the stated normalization. General quantum many-body derivation is an open direction, not proved by the algebra.
proof_scope.4428: Records report-scoped questions on faster growing times, effective singularities, condensation, quasilinear models and non-equilibrium spectra. No claimed complete current-literature survey or new resolution.
proof_scope.440A: Defines the local Maxwellian and proves Q(M,M)=0 using momentum and energy conservation. Does not characterize every collision equilibrium.
proof_scope.440B: Complete Gaussian computation of mass, momentum, stress, energy and energy flux, including momentum density rho*u and thermal central moment.
proof_scope.440C: Quotes a strengthened sufficient version of Euclidean v3 Theorem 1: a covering-cube Gaussian initial norm controls the quantity displayed in original (1.15). Retains the weighted solution bound, log-epsilon range of correlation order and parameter-dependent threshold. Also states torus v1 Theorem 1 with its joint rate/time/size condition. Research proofs remain external; no equivalence of the printed ball expression and the cube norm is asserted in high dimension.
proof_scope.440D: Derives compressible Euler moment closure conditional on local Maxwell equilibrium and the moment identities. This formal closure does not prove convergence to local equilibrium.
proof_scope.440E: Research theorem overview, not a complete standalone construction of the Hilbert coefficients. Preserves prepared data F0 through F6, nonnegativity, normalization, original weighted remainder conditions and joint scale restriction; proves only the triangle-inequality combination epsilon^theta+eta.
proof_scope.440F: Complete chain-rule calculation of the low-Mach time rescaling and Re=nu/eta. Statements about limiting fluid equations require the cited prepared-data convergence results.
proof_scope.441A: Derives the interaction-representation modal ODE and its Duhamel integral with the stated sign and L normalization; defines ternary trees and paired trees. Convergence and quantitative summation of the expansion remain external.
proof_scope.441B: Complete complex Gaussian Wick identity by independence and mixed moments, including repeated indices and factorial multiplicities.
proof_scope.441C: Defines ordinary joint cumulants by set partitions, with the covariance example; distinguishes them from the hard-sphere relative subset coefficients.
proof_scope.441D: Complete finite-coefficient moment-cumulant inversion using formal log/exp, followed by vanishing of mixed cumulants across independent groups. No analytic moment-generating function is required.
proof_scope.441E: Explains the time-reversal obstruction only for conjugation/reflection-invariant norm-only sufficient restart hypotheses; includes k-to-minus-k. Does not deny valid a posteriori small-cumulant norm bounds.
proof_scope.441F: Research proof architecture: balanced signed tree families, layers, partial expansion and retention of the current quadratic spectrum. Full canonical admissibility, cutoff orders and Proposition 3.9 errors are referenced, not replaced by the schematic description.

source_errata.issue: The survey writes exact product initial marginals for hard spheres. Literal finite-diameter exclusion forbids that identity.
source_errata.treatment: 4405-4406 and 440C use the precise grand canonical excluded product and normalized correlations from the fixed original versions.

source_errata.issue: A particle epsilon^theta error alone does not measure distance to the Euler Maxwellian.
source_errata.treatment: 440E separates particle error epsilon^theta from the prepared-data fluid error O(eta); 4410 preserves its different incompressible error and time.

source_errata.issue: Fourier 2pi, normalized Laplacian, angular collision factor and kinetic time must be changed together.
source_errata.treatment: 4412-4415 use v2 exact conventions; K has angular factor 1/2, C_report=2K, tau_v2=2alpha^2*t and tau_report=alpha^2*t. This is an explicit convention conversion, not an unverified theorem transfer.

source_errata.issue: Raw compressible velocity moments as printed do not equal u and T; the moment of v is rho*u and the raw energy includes bulk velocity. The theorem also has apparent equation/time-label slips.
source_errata.treatment: 440B calculates the moments directly; 440E uses the fixed smooth Euler interval and does not reproduce the mislabeled raw moments. No claim of an official publisher erratum.

source_errata.issue: An elementary inclusion-exclusion product must count each unordered pair once.
source_errata.treatment: 4423 indexes edges by i<j; Penrose regrouping remains a separately cited research step.

source_errata.issue: With Euclidean |x-m|, the displayed radius-one balls centered at Z^d fail to cover R^d for d>=5: the half-integer point has distance sqrt(d)/2 from the nearest lattice point. The displayed expression therefore cannot directly serve as a norm on arbitrary smooth functions in those dimensions.
source_errata.treatment: 440C defines a stronger covering-cube norm using max_j |x_j-m_j|<=1. Each Euclidean unit ball lies inside its cube, so the assumed cube bound implies the printed bound and the quoted theorem remains applicable. No high-dimensional norm equivalence or official erratum is claimed.
